title: First password collected then discarded (invalid secret)
actual_evidence: Source trace: SignupPage sends password -> POST /auth/signup; onboarding_service.py:325 stores hash_password(request.password) in TenantRegistration.password_hash; tenant_provisioning_service.py:362-367 (_clear_registration_credential) nulls password_hash at provisioning (cleanup_reason=provisioned); OwnerCredentialSetupService.consume_setup_token (owner_credential_service.py:168) hashes the SECOND (email-setup) password; _ensure_owner_user (250-292) sets the owner users.password_hash from that second password only. First password is never bound to any login credential and cannot authenticate. No source/run evidence of a real, necessary, customer-understandable purpose.

title: Zero-tenant login branch unreachable; mock-only impossible-state false-green
actual_evidence: Real /auth/login raises HTTP 401 when verified_user_id is None OR len(matches)==0 (auth.py:260-264) and never returns HTTP 200 with available_tenants=[]; the only empty-tenants response is /auth/refresh (auth.py:487). Test 'cold-start branch never references /onboarding/create-tenant' mocks mockPost to resolve with {data:{success:true,data:{...,available_tenants:[]}}} i.e. fabricates HTTP 200 + [] that the backend cannot emit -> mock-only impossible-state false-green.
